messages:
Ravi Desai: Heads-up: EdgeBox + Redwood marketplace co-launch webinar confirmed for June 14. Live demo + short hands-on lab after the talk. Need owner for press/embargo, speaker bios, lab seats, and swag returns policy.

Priya Kapoor: I'm in for speaker coordination. Can someone draft bios (50-75 words) and headshots request by EOD Fri? We need them for the marketplace listing and press deck.

Lina Gomez: I'll own bios. Quick ask: do we want partner headshots in vertical or square? Square is easiest for marketplace card.

Priya Kapoor: Square please. Also capture pronouns for bios.

Tom Howard: Lab seats: proposing 100 NA + 50 APAC live seats. We'll limit signups and provide test tokens. Who can generate ephemeral test tokens that expire after 24h?

EdgeBox Ops: We can create scoped tokens. Need a list of emails or registration IDs; else we'll mint anonymous tokens tied to session IDs.

Ravi Desai: Use registration IDs. @Elsa please ensure the registration form collects session ID and consent for token issuance.

Elsa (events): Will add fields. Also adding "I agree to receive swag" checkbox. Reminder: GDPR requires opt-in for shipping data.

Priya Kapoor: For press/embargo: PressBot flagged embargo until 6/14 14:00 PT. Who's writing the embargo release? Marketing or partner comms?

Lina Gomez: Marketing will draft joint announcement. Partner PR will have review window of 48 hours. Add that to timeline.

Tom Howard: Demo infra checklist:
- Dedicated sandbox cluster (redwood-dl-lab-prod)
- Limit CPU/GPU per session
- Pre-seeded dataset (edgebox-samples v2)
- Canary endpoint+fallback

Tom Howard: Also need a way to throttle concurrent demos if load spikes. Suggest a queue with a max concurrency of 20 sessions and a visible wait message.

EdgeBox Ops: We'll implement queue and a simple heartbeat to drop stale sessions after 10 min. We'll also provide a secondary smaller instance for the prerecorded fallback.

Ravi Desai: Good. Who's owning the prerecorded fallback walkthrough? Prefer partner does live demo and we have a Redwood fallback.

Lina Gomez: I can coordinate. @Tom can you produce a 5min Redwood fallback clip showing model call + expected outputs?

Tom Howard: Yep. Will capture logs and include a short transcript file. Format: MP4, 720p ok for smaller filesize.

Elsa (events): Swag plan: EdgeBox sending branded power banks, Redwood sending sticker + quickstart card. We need SKU list and customs values. Also set return policy: if undelivered, we'll keep for 30 days then donate. Approve?

Priya Kapoor: Approve donation policy but note we must track undeliverables and notify recipients. Also collect phone number optional for couriers.

EdgeBox Ops: For marketplace listing we need to include a short "how-to" with example CLI. Suggest this snippet for the lab runbook:

```
# quickstart
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=<SESSION_TOKEN>
redwood-cli run --model redwood-edgebox-demo --input sample_prompt.txt
```

Tom Howard: Add note: tokens revoke at session end; include TTL in session response.

Ravi Desai: Embargo timeline: draft announcement due 6/8, partner review by 6/10, final sign-off 6/12 EOD. Marketing to schedule release 6/14 14:00 PT.

Priya Kapoor: Speaker logistics: bios due 6/1, slides due 6/7, rehearsal windows 6/11 (NA) and 6/13 (APAC). Please book 30min slots.

Elsa (events): AV notes: we'll have HDMI feed for in-person presenters, Zoom for remote. Need a dedicated AV tech in the green room. Also request for captions: enable live captions + record captions file.

Ravi Desai: Legal asks: partner shared a short demo script that mentions EdgeBox benchmarks. Need legal review for comparative claims. I'll route to legal and aim for feedback within 48h.

Lina Gomez: Also confirm recording rights: partners asked to repurpose recording for their channels. We should permit with credit and linkback to Redwood marketplace. Ops OK?

Tom Howard: Fine from infra side, provided we redact any customer-sensitive data.

EdgeBox Ops: We'll sign the content license addendum. EdgeBox to send legal contact.

Elsa (events): Logistics - shipping matrix draft:
- US swag pallet -> Redwood HQ receiving (attn: Events) 6/10-6/12
- EU swag small boxes -> Partner EU hub 6/11-6/13
- Returns address: Redwood HQ returns dept.

Priya Kapoor: Add label note: "LIVE LAB KIT 14 DO NOT DELETE" and include manifest file in box. Customs values: power bank $12, sticker pack $1.50, card $0.50.

Ravi Desai: Final asks: Lina assemble press review checklist, Priya manage speaker comms, Tom build fallback clip + runbook snippets, EdgeBox Ops handle tokens and queue, Elsa finalize shipping and AV. We'll do a final dry-run 6/11 11:00 PT. Thanks all. :rocket:

PressBot: Reminder set for 6/11 11:00 PT rehearsal and 6/14 13:00 PT pre-launch check.
